user_saw: An operator could see a sandboxed command replace a protected skill path with writable content.
summary: The fix bind-mounts writable ancestors of protected skill mounts onto themselves so sandboxed processes cannot rename them.
reasoning: The oldest available source already mounted nested skill directories read-only beneath a writable workspace and left their parent directories unpinned. The fix PR credits #85591 with introducing that layout, which suggests the protection gap shipped with the feature. The available history stops at a missing parent, so I could not verify the introducing commit or its diff.
